Company Description

Join Oterra in making natural food and beverages easy, for a sustainable and healthy world.

Headquartered in Denmark, with production sites in Europe, Latin America, and the US, we’re a passionate team of over 1200 team members of 48 nationalities in 27 countries worldwide, serving 120 markets globally. As the leading worldwide provider of natural colors, we offer food and beverage manufacturers an alternative to artificial colors. Food and health are at the heart of everything we do and every day over 400 million people eat a product with our colors in it. We believe that nature got it right the first time.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Group Financial Controller with interest and experience in driving continued improvements to our financial reporting process to join us at our global headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

As Group Financial Controller, you will be part of the team responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant preparation of the Oterra Group's financial reporting. The group financial reporting is prepared in accordance with IFRS and the accounting principles applied under Oterra’s senior financing agreements.

You will report to the Head of Group Controlling & Reporting, but close collaboration with finance teams across the Group Finance, Group Tax, Group Treasury, Business Finance, and senior management is expected to ensure high-quality financial information is delivered to stakeholders.

In addition to supporting and controlling selected global sales and production subsidiaries, you will be part of developing and improving our group consolidation system, SAP Group Reporting, and related processes including data collection, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership management and validation rules.

Qualifications

We imagine that you have a relevant master’s degree or alternatively, a diploma degree and bring at least eight years of relevant experience from similar roles within a global finance organization maybe combined with experience from consulting or auditing.

You have strong knowledge of IFRS and experience with consolidation systems (e.g., SAP Group Reporting, BPC, OneStream, HFM).

Just as importantly, you are able to communicate complex financial matters in a clear and pragmatic way. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and enjoy working both independently and collaboratively across functions, cultures, and geographies.

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible. Applications will therefore be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until we have found the right match.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

•

What you could bring

• 
More than 10 years of hands-on electronics product development experience.

• 
Education in a relevant field.

• 
Proven track record of successful electronics design for multiple systems and products.

• 
A solid understanding of analog and digital electronics from low level transistor design all the way to high level system design.

Experience with high-speed designs and modern interfaces (LPDDR5, PCI-E, USB3.0, MIPI).

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

What you will do

• 
Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• 
Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• 
Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• 
Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• 
Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• 
Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• 
Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

How you will work

You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

What we're looking for

• 
7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• 
Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• 
Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• 
Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• 
Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• 
Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• 
ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

Technical Fluency

• 
You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• 
You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• 
You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

What this role is not

This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

jobs.description:
Who you are

We are looking for a dedicated, structured and development-oriented Fulfilment Operations Team Leader to join IKEA Odense. You are passionate about leadership, optimising logistics processes and achieving results through people.

This is a fixed-term position consisting of two exciting assignments. You will initially join our Outbound team, focusing on outgoing online orders, before transitioning to our Inbound team, where the focus will be on incoming goods flow. This will give you the opportunity to work with two key areas of our logistics operation and contribute to creating efficient workflows, high quality standards and great customer experiences.

In both roles, your most important task will be to deliver results through visible leadership, strong collaboration and the continuous development of both employees and processes.

To succeed in this role, it is important that you:

•Have 1–2 years of leadership experience, preferably with a focus on people and team management.

•Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

•Are well organised and able to maintain an overview in a busy and changing environment.

•Are motivated by developing people, creating engagement and achieving strong results through your team.

•Have an analytical and solution-oriented approach to operations, processes and optimisation.

•Ideally have experience in logistics – this is an advantage, but not a requirement.

•Ideally hold a forklift licence or are interested in obtaining one.

You must be comfortable working varying hours depending on your area of responsibility. In Outbound, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, while in Inbound, working hours will be 04:00–12:00.

A day in your life with us

During the first part of the position, from approximately January 2027 to May 2027, you will be the Team Leader of our Outbound operation. Together with your team, you will ensure that our online orders are handled efficiently and dispatched to our customers on time.

From May 2027, you will transition to our Inbound team, where you will cover a maternity leave position. Here, your focus will be on ensuring an efficient and well-functioning inbound goods flow, making sure that goods are handled correctly and on time and are available to the rest of our logistics operation.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•Leading, developing and motivating a team of approximately 20 employees.

•Ensuring efficient daily operations and a stable flow of outgoing online orders and incoming goods.

•Optimising outflow, workflows and processes, with a focus on productivity, quality and costs.

•Planning and coordinating resources to ensure that operational targets are achieved.

•Creating a culture focused on continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration.

•Monitoring relevant KPIs, customer satisfaction and operational performance.

•Ensuring employee well-being and actively working with sickness absence and employee retention.

•Ensuring that all work is carried out in accordance with IKEA's applicable safety rules and procedures.

Together as a Team

At IKEA Logistics, we play a central role in creating great customer experiences. Every day, we work to ensure that the right products are available, handled efficiently and moved further through the supply chain, always keeping the customer at the centre of everything we do.

We believe there is always room for improvement and that great results are achieved through engaged employees, clear leadership and strong collaboration.

As a Team Leader, you will play an important role in translating our goals into tangible results in everyday operations. You must be able to provide direction for your team, develop employees' skills and ensure that we continuously find new and better ways of working.

Questions and support? Let's connect!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Fulfilment Operations Manager Rune Nielsen at rune.nielsen@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Additional information

•This is a fixed-term position with 1st of January 2027 as expected start date until summer 2028.

•The position is based on an average of 37 hours per week.

•From January to May 2027, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, depending on operational requirements.

•From June 2027 until summer 2028, working hours will generally be 04:00–12:00.

•You must be willing to work additional hours and overtime when required by operational needs.

•Weekend work approximately every third weekend.

•You must also be willing to participate in the store's Duty/Floor management rotation at selected times.

•Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis

• Please apply latest on the 1st of december.

jobs.occupation: International Customer Success Manager for a Copenhagen grid-tech start-up
jobs.description:
Are you a customer-facing project manager who thrives on paving the way to success for B2B customers? Do you speak fluent German and English – and perhaps Spanish/Italian? Do you see yourself in a fast-growing start-up with an international team that is securing critical electrical infrastructure?

Then you could be Oktogrid’s new Customer Success Manager!

About Oktogrid

Oktogrid helps secure critical infrastructure by bringing power transformers online for higher reliability and a more sustainable operation. Oktogrid’s sensor solution significantly accelerates the path to getting access to the right data to support operators with the necessary insights for their decision-making.

Founded in 2020. Oktogrid has the continued backing of major European investors, including ABB Electrification and Elewit Ventures, and works with a wide range of grid operators across Europe. The company has 14 employees, most of whom are based at the Copenhagen office, with sales colleagues based in Germany and the Netherlands. Oktogrid also works with an international development team. English is the company language.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, who also heads up sales, you will ensure that Oktogrid’s customers get off to a strong start and support them on their journey as they continue to benefit of the value from the solution. As the Customer Success Manager, you will follow each new customer closely throughout the first 3-9 months – from installation workshops to confidently onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform.

You will remain their trusted point of contact for the entire customer journey, while your experience in project coordination will ensure that the right expertise from your colleagues is involved whenever needed. Your job is not to acquire new customers, but to build strong relationships with existing ones, identify new needs and plant the seeds for further collaboration. You will be based at the Copenhagen office, with occasional travel.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Running a structured onboarding process for new customers – from project kick-off workshops to onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform

• 
Following up closely with customers and holding regular check-ins to ensure that they get the value they expect

• 
Owning a portfolio of Danish and international customers, with a focus on German-speaking markets

• 
Engaging with a rich map of stakeholders within each customer organisation – for example, the operations managers in each region – so that the solution becomes part of their day-to-day work

• 
Bringing in Oktogrid’s technical experts when customers need in-depth answers about transformers, deeper data analytics or software integrations

• 
Identifying new needs and opportunities – such as additional analytics modules and reports – and passing them on to the product and operations teams

• 
Capturing customer feedback and success stories for Product and Marketing

• 
Building and continuously improving Oktogrid’s Customer Success process and playbook

About you

A background in utilities or within energy is a plus, but not a requirement – Oktogrid’s experts are at hand when in-depth expertise is needed. What matters most is that you are excellent at building trust, maintaining close dialogue with customers and picking up on when to involve your extended team at Oktogrid. Having previously worked within energy, telecoms, IT, SaaS or other B2B industries in which you have delivered complex solutions to large customers are relevant fields of experience. We envisage that you have:

• 
5-10 years’ experience in Customer Success or related customer-facing roles with B2B customers

• 
Experience of working with structured customer processes – ideally gained in a medium-sized company where you have had broad responsibility

• 
Experience in delivering complex solutions and managing long-term customer relationships, rather than having ambitions of driving transactional sales

• 
Technical understanding and the ability to explain complex solutions clearly to expert as well as non-expert stakeholders

• 
A proactive approach – you bring your own ideas to the table and take ownership of improving the way things are done

• 
Genuine curiosity about customers’ needs – you spot opportunities that create further value for them

• 
The drive to succeed in a fast-growing start-up as part of a high-performing, international team – and a preference for working from the office in close contact with customers and colleagues

• 
Fluent in German and English, written and spoken. Spanish and Italian would be a strong advantage, as many customers prefer to communicate in their own language

• 
Experience with utilities and an understanding of asset management practices would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

• 
A valid permit to live and work in Denmark (EU/EEA citizenship or a Danish work permit)

Oktogrid offers

• 
A key role with real influence in a company actively driving a meaningful climate impact

• 
Office-based work with flexible working hours, the option of working from home one day a week and a partly paid company lunch scheme every day

• 
A modern office space in Copenhagen at the border between Vesterbro and Frederiksberg, located close to green areas and a vibrant hub where innovation meets great city culture

• 
A salary based on qualifications, and a company-wide bonus scheme

Interested?

Apply as soon as possible by clicking the application button and uploading your CV and, if you wish, a cover letter, both in English.

If you have any questions, please contact Martin Nielsen, Headhunter & Partner at Landau Headhunting, on +45 8122 8180. Landau Headhunting is managing the recruitment process on behalf of Oktogrid, so please direct all enquiries to us. We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you! Read more about Oktogrid at https://oktogrid.io

**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

****Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

The Global Service Specialist serves as FLS’s primary onsite representative and is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution. This position requires extensive international travel and the ability to work independently under demanding conditions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute onsite erection, installation, alignment, and commissioning of mechanical systems and I&C activities for thickeners, flotation cells, and related separation equipment.

• Lead pre‑commissioning and commissioning processes to ensure equipment meets design, safety, and performance requirements.

• Support operational startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of equipment performance.

• Conduct inspections, testing, calibration, and verification of mechanical and control‑related systems.

• Coordinate onsite project activities, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project management teams to resolve technical issues.

• Prepare accurate and professional documentation, including installation records, commissioning reports, and service summaries.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, providing training, guidance, and technical support.

• Represent FLS with professionalism and integrity in all customer interactions.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Strong mechanical background with hands‑on experience in Installation & Commissioning (I&C) of industrial process equipment.

• Experience with thickeners, flotation cells, clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, or similar industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions under pressure.

• Strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and documentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high‑quality technical reports.

• Ability and willingness to travel internationally up to 70% of the time.

• Professional demeanor with the ability to represent the company effectively onsite.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in commissioning or startup of industrial process systems.

• Background in mining, minerals processing, water treatment, or heavy industrial environments.

• Multilingual capabilities or experience working in multicultural settings.

• Ability to meet all medical and physical fitness requirements necessary to obtain work authorization for high‑altitude job sites.

**Competencies

**

• Technical proficiency in mechanical systems and industrial equipment

• Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities

• Customer service orientation

• Professional communication and reporting skills

• Ability to perform effectively in high‑pressure environments

• Self‑motivation and independence in field operations
